features: 【 Effortless Bluetooth Pairing with FitPro App】 Connect your smart fitness band quickly by enabling Bluetooth on your smartphone and downloading the free FitPro App from the Play Store. Once paired, enjoy automatic time sync, call alerts, SMS notifications, and social media updates directly on your wrist for seamless daily use.

【 Continuous Heart Rate, Blood Pressure & SpO2 Monitoring】 Keep track of your health with real-time monitoring of heart rate, blood pressure, and oxygen saturation (SpO2). Accurate readings throughout the day help you understand your wellness, manage stress, and make informed lifestyle choices.

【 Comprehensive Sleep Tracking & Analysis】 Monitor your sleep patterns including deep sleep, light sleep, and awake periods. Gain detailed insights into your nightly rest to optimize sleep quality and improve overall health and daily energy levels.

【 Daily Activity & Fitness Tracking】 Track your steps, distance traveled, and calories burned during walking, jogging, or daily routines. Set personal goals, stay motivated, and maintain an active lifestyle effortlessly. Ideal for fitness enthusiasts and health-conscious users.

【 IPX7 Waterproof & Sweat-Resistant Design】 Built to withstand sweat, rain, and light splashes, this smart band is suitable for workouts, outdoor sports, and everyday wear. Durable and reliable, it supports your fitness journey in all conditions without worry.
